subject: english
stem: A delivery box had the wrong address. Nora called the shop, and a driver collected it before it reached the wrong home. Which is the best summary?
options: Nora reported an address error, so the box was redirected in time.
Nora saw a brown box with a white label.
A driver owned a very large truck.
The box was certainly the best delivery ever.

optionRationales.reason: Nora reported an address error, so the box was redirected in time.：保留問題、關鍵行動與結果。
Nora saw a brown box with a white label.：只留裝飾細節。
A driver owned a very large truck.：未提且非主線。
The box was certainly the best delivery ever.：加入無證據評價。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「摘要保留初始目標或問題、關鍵因果轉折與結果，刪除不影響因果鏈的細節」可推出 Nora reported an address error, so the box was redirected in time.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Nora reported an address error, so the box was redirected in time. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
